propositions: Plan-review criterion T15 must be added to reward proving risky runtime mechanisms via fast out-of-loop experiments before committing them to slow codified delivery loops.
T15 applies only when a mechanism is delivered through an automated pipeline, that pass is slow/costly, and correctness is runtime-only and unreachable by static checks.
T15 findings must name the specific risk, commit to a fast proof path (local/emulated or real-target manual experiment), prove before codifying, and clean up throwaway artifacts narrowly.
T10's rubric must be partitioned to scope only durable infrastructure, explicitly excluding transient de-risk experiments from its evaluation.
The criteria-guide, registry validators, and writing-a-passing-plan guide must be regenerated to include T15 guidance and the T10 scope clause.
